title: Probability Hypothesis Density Tracker
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Probability_Hypothesis_Density_Tracker.md
text: Multi-sensor, multi-object PHD tracker, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Sensor configurations} sets Configurations of tracking sensors; {Tracker identifier} sets the unique tracker identifier, {Detection partition function} sets the function to partition detections into detection cells, {Assignment threshold} sets the threshold of selecting detections for component, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Maximum number of tracks}, {Maximum number of components}, {Update sensor configurations with time}, {Track state parameters} sets the parameters of track state reference frame, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Birth rate of new targets}, {Death rate of components}, {Threshold for initializing tentative tracks}, {Threshold for track confirmation}, {Threshold for track deletion} sets the threshold for component, {Threshold for components merging}, {Thresholds for label management}, {Prediction time source} sets the source of prediction time, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks, {Enable information output} enables output port for analysis, {Source of output bus name} sets the source of output track bus name and {Source of output info bus name} sets the source of output information bus name. Values come from the instance.
